name: When should I call a professional restoration company for a sewage backup?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional restoration company for a sewage backup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional restoration company immediately upon discovering any sewage backup in your restaurant. Sewage water is considered a biohazard, and improper handling can pose serious health risks and lead to further property damage. Professionals have the specialized equipment, training, and expertise to safely and effectively remove contaminants, clean, disinfect, dry, and restore the affected areas according to health regulations. Attempting to manage it yourself can be dangerous and ineffective.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional restoration company immediately for any sewage backup as it's a biohazard requiring specialized cleanup and disinfection.
